#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
long long stirling[5001][5001];

long long modInverse(long long x, long long p) {
    return power(x, p - 2, p);
}

long long power(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1)
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    stirling[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 5001; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < 5001; j++) {
            stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i - 1][j - 1] % MOD) + (j * stirling[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            stirling[i][j] %= MOD;
        }
    }

    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    istringstream iss(line);
    long long n, m;
    int k;
    iss >> n >> m >> k;

    long long p = modInverse(m, MOD);
    long long val = 1;
    long long answer = 0;
    long long probability = 1;

    for (int i = k; i > 0; i--) {
        val *= (n - (k - i));
        val %= MOD;
        probability *= p;
        probability %= MOD;
        answer += (((val * probability) % MOD) * stirling[k][k - i + 1]) % MOD;
        answer %= MOD;
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
